```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18, 20]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'yarn'
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: yarn test
      - run: yarn build

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [20]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'yarn'
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: yarn lint
```
